additional_info.body:
Hello Alexander,
As we checked today, there was a bug on the SECC which is solved by a simple restart of the component.
This topic is already addressed to R&D, as soon as we have any updates we will convey them to you.
For now, the workaround is to simply restart the charger or reach out to me. The only difference is the down time of the charger.
As reported, all outlets are again green and ready to charge.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
